## Runtime vs. IMDb Ratings

This page explores the relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings. @fig-runtime-rating shows whether longer films tend to receive higher or lower ratings.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings."

# import libraries
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# load dataset
films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

# make scatter plot
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])

# add labels
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")

# display plot
plt.show()
```

## Mean IMDb Rating by Decade

The following table shows the average IMDb rating for films released in each decade.

```{python}
#| echo: true
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10

films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
